headline: Beiersdorf Keeps Guidance Despite Q3 Sales Drop Led by Nivea Weakness
summary: Beiersdorf confirmed its full-year guidance despite reporting a decline in third-quarter sales, dragged down by lower performance in its flagship Nivea skin care brand.
why: Beiersdorf is a leading European consumer goods manufacturer; sales figures for its global brands provide insight into international retail consumer demand.

impacts.name: Beiersdorf
impacts.why: Reiterated full-year targets cushion the stock against near-term quarterly sales contraction in Nivea.
